h1: Custom Embroidery Office for Branded Apparel & Accessories
metaDescription: Order custom embroidery office items for your team. Add your logo to apparel and accessories. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Embroidery adds a professional, textured finish to your office gear that screen printing can't match. From fleece mittens to Sherpa blankets, embroidered logos hold up wash after wash without fading or peeling. Choose this decoration method for premium items like the Eddie Bauer Soft Shell Jacket or the Charlie Cotton Weekender—pieces your team will wear proudly in the office or on the go. Thread colors can be matched to your brand palette for a cohesive look.
heroAltText: Custom embroidery office items with embroidered logos on fleece mittens and a Sherpa blanket
